metadata.description: Vu Ha's Claude Code mods, skills, hooks and commands

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: A band above the prompt that breaks the context window down by category, like /context

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: A pane listing the project's and your custom subagents, each with a run button

plugins.name: mr-panel
plugins.description: A pane listing your open GitLab merge requests and the ones waiting for your review

plugins.name: jira-band
plugins.description: A row above the prompt showing the Jira ticket named in the current git branch

plugins.name: cost-guard
plugins.description: Session cost and rate-limit usage on the status line, with a toast when a threshold is crossed

plugins.name: turn-timer
plugins.description: Live turn time and tool-call count on the status line, with a toast after a long turn

plugins.name: vuha-toolkit
plugins.description: Skills (standup, release-notes) and hooks (lint on edit in prod projects, macOS notification when a long turn ends)
